kurz: Boil a liquid uncovered until part of the water has evaporated. It becomes stronger and silkier.
bild_im_kopf: Like editing a text: fewer words, the same message, a stronger effect.
was_passiert: Simmering uncovered, water evaporates. Aromas, sugar, salt and gelatine stay behind. A wide pot with lots of surface is much faster.
schritte: Bring the liquid to the boil in a wide pot or pan.
Keep an eye on the level, e.g. down to half or a third.
